int_order_lines:
select
    i.order_id as order_id,
    i.order_item_id as order_item_id,
    i.product_id as product_id,
    i.seller_id as seller_id,
    i.price as item_price,
    i.freight_value as freight_value,
    o.order_status as order_status,
    o.purchased_at as purchased_at,
    o.customer_id as customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id as customer_unique_id
from {{ ref('stg_order_items') }} as i
join {{ ref('stg_orders') }} as o on o.order_id = i.order_id
left join {{ ref('stg_customers') }} as c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
int_orders:
select
    o.order_id as order_id,
    o.customer_id as customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id as customer_unique_id,
    o.order_status as order_status,
    o.purchased_at as purchased_at,
    o.delivered_at as delivered_at,
    o.estimated_delivery_at as estimated_delivery_at
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }} as o
left join {{ ref('stg_customers') }} as c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id
int_order_reviews:
with ranked as (
    select
        r.order_id,
        r.review_id,
        r.review_score,
        r.review_answered_at,
        row_number() over (
            partition by r.order_id
            order by r.review_answered_at desc nulls last, r.review_id desc
        ) as rn
    from {{ ref('stg_reviews') }} as r
)
select
    ranked.order_id as order_id,
    ranked.review_id as review_id,
    ranked.review_score as review_score,
    ranked.review_answered_at as review_answered_at,
    o.purchased_at as purchased_at
from ranked
join {{ ref('stg_orders') }} as o on o.order_id = ranked.order_id
where ranked.rn = 1
